BEFORE  HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE PRAMOD KUMAR AGRAWAL  ON THE 8 th OF JULY, 2025  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 27698 of 2025  PYAR SINGH  Versus
THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH

Appearance:
 Shri Mithilesh Pd.Tripathi - Advocate for the applicant  Ms. Garima Tiwari - Panel Lawyer for State.

ORDER This is the second application under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.475/2024 registered at Police Station - Khaknar, District Burhanpur (M.P.) for offence punishable under Sections 363, 366-A, 376, 376(2)(n), 376(2)(k), 305 of IPC and Section 5(j)(ii)/ 6 of POCSO Act.
The applicant is in custody since 25.07.2024.
Previous bail application was dismissed as withdrawn.
2. As per the prosecution story, prosecutrix ran away with the applicant and stayed in the house of applicant and co-accused.
It is alleged that applicant committed rape upon the prosecutrix/deceased and applicant and co-accused abetted the deceased to commit suicide.
On the basis of which, offence was registered against the present applicant under the aforesaid section.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
He is in custody since 25.07.2024.

It is submitted that mother of the deceased (PW-1), brother of the deceased (PW- 2) father of the deceased (PW-3) have been examined before the trial Court in NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:30182 2 MCRC-27698-2025 which they have not supported the prosecution story.
The conclusion of the trial will take considerable time, therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the bail application and prayed for it's rejection.

sentences.text: Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of BNSS.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
